WORKING NOTES

IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight light
brown hair parted in the center walks through a
warm interior with framed prints and a patterned
carpet. She wears a burgundy velvet long-sleeve
crop top with a fitted waist, a wide leopard-print
maxi skirt with a black belt, and carries a black
handbag. A pendant necklace sits at her throat. Her
expression is calm and direct. Warm, golden lamp
light. Palette of burgundy, leopard tan, and deep
brown. Bold and cozy, in the style of a 1990s
sitcom still.
